# Fuenzer Research - Full System & Academic Architecture Documentation

> Comprehensive documentation for LLMs, AI agents, and academic search engines.
> Standard specification: https://llmstxt.org/
> For the concise summary version, see [llms.txt](https://research.fuenzer.web.id/llms.txt)

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition

**Fuenzer Research** (https://research.fuenzer.web.id/) is an AI-powered scientific discovery and academic research platform engineered to bridge the gap between global publication repositories and local Indonesian academic indexing frameworks.

- **Primary Goal**: Accelerate literature review, reference discovery, citation generation, and academic synthesis for students, researchers, lecturers, and academic institutions.
- **Founder & Maintainer**: Ridwan Yoga Suryantara
- **Canonical Production URL**: `https://research.fuenzer.web.id/`
- **Supported Languages**: Indonesian (primary interface and synthesis target), English (global metadata).

---

## 2. Core Academic Problems Solved

### 2.1 Fragmented National & Global Indexing
- **Global Repositories**: Platforms like Scopus, Google Scholar, and OpenAlex index global scientific output efficiently, but lack granular visibility into Indonesian national indexing schemes (specifically SINTA accreditation tiers).
- **Indonesian Repositories**: The Indonesian National Database (Garuda / Garba Rujukan Digital) and SINTA (Science and Technology Index) possess rich local literature, but traditional portals lack fast programmable APIs, real-time cross-database federation, and full-text search indexing.
- **Fuenzer Solution**: Fuenzer Research queries OpenAlex and a curated local Garuda SQLite database concurrently while dynamically checking SINTA journal accreditation mapping in real-time.

### 2.2 SINTA Tier (1–6) Real-Time Verification
- Indonesian higher education institutions mandate publication in specific SINTA tiers (SINTA 1 through SINTA 6, where S1 is the highest accreditation and S6 is entry-level).
- Authors normally have to cross-check journal ISSNs manually across separate portals.
- Fuenzer maps SINTA tiers on every search result card automatically via a pre-compiled JSON hash dictionary derived from official indexed records.

### 2.3 Curated Garuda Database Search (SQLite FTS)
- We transformed 652,144 cleaned Indonesian publications (filtered from an initial Kaggle scraping corpus of 3.6M records, focusing on recent and high-density publications) into a local SQLite database indexed for rapid sub-second full-text search.

### 2.4 Abstract Review Overhead & Synthesis Bottleneck
- Scanning dozens of abstracts to extract methodology, objectives, and conclusions consumes hours.
- Fuenzer integrates Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite to generate an objective 150-word synthesis in under 5 seconds, restricted strictly to the user's selected abstracts.

---

## 3. Key Capabilities & Platform Features

### 3.1 Concurrent Federated Academic Search
A single search query triggers concurrent execution across multiple academic data providers:
1. **OpenAlex API**: Accessing 200M+ global scholarly works, authors, and citations.
2. **Garuda Local Database**: Accessing 652K+ curated Indonesian national scholarly papers via SQLite FTS.
3. **Google Books API**: Querying 160M+ indexed volumes for high-density monograph and book references.
4. **Scopus & SINTA Journal Cross-Matching**: Real-time ISSN and title mapping against ~700 accredited journals and ~7,000 articles.

### 3.2 Dynamic AI Synthesis Engine
- **Engine**: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
- **Role**: Fuenzer Synthesis Engine
- **Tone**: Rigorous, academic, neutral, concise (Indonesian).
- **Format**: A single coherent paragraph of up to 150 words summarizing the core synthesis of selected literature.
- **Anti-Hallucination Constraints**:
  - The backend strictly tokenizes only `Title`, `Abstract`, and `Year`.
  - The temperature is locked at `0.3` to eliminate creative divergence.
  - The model prompt strictly dictates: *"DILARANG menggunakan pengetahuan eksternal. Jika jawaban tidak ada di abstrak yang diberikan, nyatakan: 'Literatur yang ditemukan tidak cukup untuk menyimpulkan hal ini.'"*

### 3.3 Contextual Multi-Reference Comparative Q&A (Library Compare)
- Within the Personal Library, users can select up to 5 specific saved references.
- Users can query the AI with targeted research questions (e.g., *"Bandingkan metodologi yang digunakan antara paper A dan paper B"*).
- The AI synthesizes comparative findings solely based on the text of the selected papers.

### 3.4 Multi-Format Citation & Bibliography Exporter
- **Citation Formats**: Real-time generation for:
  - APA 7th Edition
  - Harvard Reference Format
  - MLA 9th Edition
  - Chicago Manual of Style (Author-Date)
  - Vancouver System
- **File Exports**:
  - **BibTeX (`.bib`)**: Formatted for LaTeX documents, Overleaf, and Zotero/Mendeley imports.
  - **RIS Format (`.ris`)**: Standard format for EndNote and Reference Managers.
  - **PDF Batch Export**: Generates formatted reference summaries bundled inside a single `.zip` archive.
  - **Literature Review CSV Matrix**: Exports key fields (Title, Authors, Year, Index, Abstract snippet, Citations) for structured review tables.

### 3.5 Personal Workspace & Cross-Device Sync
- Firebase Authentication with Google OAuth and Email/Password.
- Multi-folder library management with Firestore cloud synchronization.
- Public read-only shareable links (`/shared/library/...` and `/shared/workspace/...`) with a "Fork Workspace" capability for peer collaboration.

---

## 4. Technical Architecture & Stack

```mermaid
graph TD
    Client[React 19 Frontend SPA] -->|HTTPS / REST API| Fiber[Golang 1.25 Fiber Backend]
    Fiber -->|Concurrent Goroutine 1| OpenAlex[OpenAlex API]
    Fiber -->|Concurrent Goroutine 2| GBooks[Google Books API]
    Fiber -->|Concurrent Goroutine 3| SQLite[Garuda SQLite DB 652K]
    Fiber -->|In-Memory Map| SINTA[SINTA Dict Mapper]
    Fiber -->|Prompt + Abstracts| Gemini[Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite]
    Client -->|Direct SDK Auth & Sync| Firebase[Firebase Auth & Firestore]
```

### 4.1 Frontend
- **Framework**: React 19, Vite, TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Dark / Light mode persistence
- **State Management**: Zustand (UI state, search parameters, library collections)
- **Data Fetching**: TanStack React Query (caching and automatic deduplication)
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **Export Utilities**: JSZip, jsPDF

### 4.2 Backend
- **Language & Runtime**: Golang 1.25
- **Web Framework**: Fiber v2 (high-performance fasthttp engine)
- **Concurrency**: Goroutines with sync.WaitGroup and timeout contexts for sub-second concurrent provider queries
- **Security & Headers**: Strict CSP with Trusted Types (`require-trusted-types-for 'script'`), CORS restriction, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options
- **Deployment**: Google Cloud Run (Containerized Docker Alpine image, us-central1)

### 4.3 Databases & Data Storage
- **Garuda Database**: SQLite 3 database (`garuda_articles_data.db`) with FTS5 virtual tables for rapid keyword indexing.
- **SINTA Mapping Table**: JSON in-memory hash map for O(1) journal ISSN and title matching.
- **Firestore**: User library persistence, custom folders, and shared workspace snapshots.

---

## 5. API Reference (Public Endpoints)

Base URL: `https://research.fuenzer.web.id/api/v1`

### 5.1 POST `/research`
Queries academic databases and optionally triggers Gemini synthesis.
- **Payload**:
  ```json
  {
    "query": "string (required, max 200 chars)",
    "filter": "all | indonesia | global",
    "sources": ["sinta", "garuda", "openalex", "googlebooks"],
    "skip_synthesis": false
  }
  ```
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "query": "string",
    "total_results": 24,
    "synthesis": "Sintesis literatur berbasis Gemini...",
    "results": [
      {
        "id": "openalex:W123456",
        "title": "Judul Publikasi",
        "authors": ["Penulis 1", "Penulis 2"],
        "year": 2024,
        "source_type": "openalex",
        "sinta_tier": "S1",
        "citation_count": 12,
        "abstract": "Abstrak artikel...",
        "url": "https://doi.org/..."
      }
    ]
  }
  ```

### 5.2 POST `/ask`
Contextual comparative Q&A restricted to provided abstracts.
- **Payload**:
  ```json
  {
    "question": "Apa perbedaan metode penelitian yang digunakan?",
    "papers": [
      { "title": "Paper A", "abstract": "...", "year": 2023 },
      { "title": "Paper B", "abstract": "...", "year": 2024 }
    ]
  }
  ```
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "answer": "Berdasarkan kedua paper yang dianalisis, Paper A menggunakan pendekatan..."
  }
  ```

### 5.3 GET `/autocomplete?q={prefix}`
Returns fast keyword suggestions derived from academic terms.

---

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q1: Apa itu Fuenzer Research dan AI apa yang digunakannya?
**Jawaban**: Fuenzer Research adalah mesin penemuan ilmiah bertenaga AI yang dirancang untuk menjembatani metodologi riset akademis dengan kecerdasan buatan tingkat lanjut. Platform ini menggunakan model **Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite** untuk mensintesis literatur akademis dengan ketelitian, kecepatan tinggi, dan akurasi yang dijamin bebas dari halusinasi eksternal.

### Q2: Database global dan lokal apa saja yang diakses?
**Jawaban**: Fuenzer Research mengintegrasikan repositori global terkemuka melalui **OpenAlex API** (200M+ publikasi) dan **Google Books API**, serta mengintegrasikan database nasional Indonesia yang mencakup repositori **SINTA** (~700 jurnal terakreditasi dan ~7.000 artikel) dan database lokal SQLite **Garuda** berisi 652.144 artikel ilmiah terindeks.

### Q3: Bagaimana cara kerja integrasi akreditasi SINTA?
**Jawaban**: Sistem melakukan pencarian paralel dan mencocokkan ISSN serta nama jurnal publikasi secara real-time dengan basis data akreditasi SINTA nasional. Setiap kartu referensi secara langsung menampilkan lencana akreditasi (SINTA 1 hingga SINTA 6).

### Q4: Apakah sintesis AI dapat dipercaya bebas dari halusinasi?
**Jawaban**: Ya. Arsitektur backend menerapkan *temperature setting* ketat pada nilai `0.3` dan aturan prompt imperatif yang melarang injeksi pengetahuan eksternal. Gemini hanya diizinkan menyimpulkan informasi berdasarkan teks abstrak yang secara eksplisit disuplai dalam payload.

### Q5: Format ekspor apa saja yang didukung?
**Jawaban**: Fuenzer Research mendukung salin instan dan unduh sitasi dalam 5 gaya standar (APA 7th, Harvard, MLA 9th, Chicago, Vancouver), ekspor bibliografi massal dalam format **BibTeX (`.bib`)** dan **RIS (`.ris`)**, berkas **PDF ringkasan batch (ZIP)**, serta file **CSV Matriks Tinjauan Literatur**.
